title: Uninstall a GNOME extension
summary: Remove a specific GNOME Shell extension from your system. This deletes the extension files, so you will need to reinstall it if you want to use it again.

steps.explain: Use the uninstall command with the specific extension ID to remove it.

placeholders.name: EXTENSION_ID
placeholders.description: The unique ID of the extension to uninstall

rollback.explain: Reinstall the extension from the GNOME Extensions website or your package manager.

warnings: This action removes the extension files. You will need to download and install the extension again to use it.
